title: This issue occurs when NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured as a proxy, the proxied server name includes…
description: A use-after-free vulnerability exists in NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source when configured as a proxy with variable server names and certain SSI or mirror directives. This flaw can be triggered by a specially crafted HTTP request, potentially causing worker process crashes, memory corruption, or remote code execution if ASLR is bypassed or disabled. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.1. No affected versions or patch information are provided, and no known exploits are reported in the wild.
